title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): code blocks preview code, charts and diagrams inline in Chat
summary: The briefing overlooks Microsoft's documented Cloud Policy for disabling code previews in Copilot Chat and incorrectly says Microsoft has not described running previews. The mixed licensing model is also unsupported; the sources establish product-level requirements, not mixed entitlement for code blocks.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and controls[0].api; summary; Governance controls; front matter: changes
claims.claim: No setting is documented for switching off code-block previews in Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Block code previews only: Disable Enable code previews for AI-generated content in Microsoft Copilot Chat and Copilot Pages; leave Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks enabled
claims.fix: Replace the existing row's UI absence with 'Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Configure Settings > Enable code previews for AI-generated content in Microsoft Copilot Chat and Copilot Pages', citing https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/loop/cpcn-admin-configuration. Use scope 'user' and note: 'Enabled and Not configured allow code previews; Disabled prevents Copilot from running previews in Chat and Pages. This is a broader preview control, not a separate switch for the new inline layout.' Leave api null: the Graph admin-setting reference and targeted API/PowerShell search found no operation for this policy. Replace statements that no preview control exists with the policy's documented reach.
